Plan and decision rules written first (EXPLICIT_BETA_PLAN.md). Allocator gains
beta_target (b'w = c); its tests were run before the change (failed: unknown
argument) and pass after; target 0 is bitwise identical to the old default and
the original 38 checks still pass. Engine options beta_shrinkage / beta_target,
off by default (package behaviour unchanged; package checks pass).

betas better on 97% of dates (MSE 0.0393 vs 0.0431); eta settles near 0.18.

R27 rejected under frozen rule; matched-diagonal control; follow-up report and note

R27 full-fee run: net Sharpe 1.167 vs packaged V2 1.243 (95% paired ranges
include zero), realized beta 0.026 vs 0.047, net investment 24% vs 40%.
Rejected as specified; not tuned.
Matched-marginal control (same marginal variances, no correlations): 0.938,
so V2's gain over a C09-like book comes from the correlation structure
(control book sizing not matched; gross cap active).

disposition; the handoff note now reflects the beta mechanism, the 0.3 penalty
as a chosen exposure penalty, row ranges, and candidate-under-review status.

Fix V2 session reset, panel layout and allocator certificate; beta diagnostics

Engineering (verification/V2_FIX_PLAN.md written first; checks failed on the
unfixed package and pass after the fix, exit status binding):
- forecast() starts a scoring session and resets the rebalance risk state and
  warm start (restart on a different equal-length history now matches a fresh run)
- basis() canonicalizes each characteristic panel to C-contiguous float64
- allocator returns a certificate (caps, hedge, duality gap) and resumes the
  joint solve once if it fails; 3,527/3,527 real calls certified, max gap 1.3e-17
- real-data ledger identical to the pre-fix package (max diff 0.0)

Evidence: daily ledgers committed; comparison.json regenerated with all 25
variants and n-L+1 block starts; drift test uses identical observed/null rows.

Beta diagnostics: conditional on the 26 characteristics the beta factor has
market slope -0.048 (NW t -19.7) and no significant intercept; estimated betas
regress ~17.5% toward one; a zero-alpha synthetic market reproduces the pattern.
Off-by-default risk_beta_column option and the frozen R27 plan added.
